verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS has a public pay-as-you-go pricing page that mentions usage-based charges, including a lower price for multitrack and an hourly rate for server-side composition. A community member also modeled input and output costs from the published rates without contacting sales, which suggests per-unit pricing is public. However, the evidence never quotes an actual per-participant-minute or per-bandwidth rate, so modeling granularity is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-participant-minute or per-GB/hour rate figures in the evidence, documented unit definitions for real-time stage participants.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales
